001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004
005import pkg_entities.Item;
006import pkg_entities.Room;
007
008import java.io.BufferedReader;
009import java.io.FileReader;
010import java.io.IOException;
011
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013
014/**
015 * Implements the {@code load} command, restoring game state from a save file.
016 *
017 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
018 * @version 2026.05.08
019 */
020public class LoadCommand extends Command {
021    /** Creates the command. */
022    public LoadCommand() {}
023
024    /**
025     * Loads player, room, item, and moving-trainer state.
026     *
027     * @param pGameEngine the game engine to restore into
028     * @return always {@code false}; loading does not end the game
029     */
030    public boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
031        if (!this.hasSecondWord()) {
032            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Load from what file? Usage: load <filename>");
033            return false;
034        }
035
036        String vFileName = this.getSecondWord() + ".sav";
037
038        try (BufferedReader vReader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(vFileName))) {
039            String vLine;
040
041            // Clear player inventory first
042            for (String vItemName :new ArrayList<>(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItems().keySet())) {
043                pGameEngine.getPlayer().removeItem(vItemName);
044            }
045
046            // Clear back stack
047            pGameEngine.getPlayer().getPreviousRooms().clear();
048
049            while ((vLine = vReader.readLine()) != null) {
050                if (vLine.startsWith("PLAYER_NAME:")) {
051                    pGameEngine.getPlayer().setName(vLine.substring(12));
052
053                } else if (vLine.startsWith("CURRENT_ROOM:")) {
054                    Room vRoom = pGameEngine.getRoomById(vLine.substring(13));
055                    if (vRoom != null) {
056                        pGameEngine.getPlayer().setCurrentRoom(vRoom);
057                    }
058
059                } else if (vLine.startsWith("MONEY:")) {
060                    pGameEngine.getPlayer().setMoney(Integer.parseInt(vLine.substring(6)));
061
062                } else if (vLine.startsWith("INVENTORY:")) {
063                    String vItems = vLine.substring(10);
064                    if (!vItems.isEmpty()) {
065                        for (String vPair : vItems.split(";")) {
066                            if (!vPair.isEmpty()) {
067                                String[] vParts = vPair.split("-");
068                                if (vParts.length == 2) {
069                                    pGameEngine.getPlayer().addItem(vParts[0],new Item(vParts[0],Integer.parseInt(vParts[1])));
070                                }
071                            }
072                        }
073                    }
074
075                } else if (vLine.startsWith("BACK_STACK:")) {
076                    String vRooms = vLine.substring(11);
077                    if (!vRooms.isEmpty()) {
078                        for (String vRoomId : vRooms.split(",")) {
079                            if (!vRoomId.isEmpty()) {
080                                Room vRoom = pGameEngine.getRoomById(vRoomId);
081                                if (vRoom != null) {
082                                    pGameEngine.getPlayer().getPreviousRooms().push(vRoom);
083                                }
084                            }
085                        }
086                    }
087
088                } else if (vLine.startsWith("MTRAINER:")) {
089                    String vData = vLine.substring(9);
090                    String[] vParts = vData.split("-");
091                    if (vParts.length == 3) {
092                        String vName = vParts[0];
093                        boolean vDefeated = Boolean.parseBoolean(vParts[1]);
094                        String vRoomId = vParts[2];
095
096                        for (pkg_entities.MovingTrainer vTrainer :
097                                pGameEngine.getMovingTrainers()) {
098                            if (vTrainer.getName().equals(vName)) {
099                                vTrainer.setDefeated(vDefeated);
100
101                                Room vOldRoom = vTrainer.getCurrentRoom();
102                                Room vNewRoom = pGameEngine.getRoomById(vRoomId);
103                                if (vOldRoom != null && vNewRoom != null && !vOldRoom.equals(vNewRoom)) {
104                                    vOldRoom.removeTrainer(vName);
105                                    vNewRoom.addTrainer(vTrainer);
106                                    vTrainer.setCurrentRoom(vNewRoom);
107                                }
108                                break;
109                            }
110                        }
111                    }
112
113                } else if (vLine.startsWith("ROOM:")) {
114                    String vData = vLine.substring(5);
115                    String[] vParts = vData.split("-");
116                    if (vParts.length == 2) {
117                        String vRoomId = vParts[0];
118                        String vItemsData = vParts[1];
119
120                        Room vRoom = pGameEngine.getRoomById(vRoomId);
121                        if (vRoom != null) {
122                            // Clear existing items
123                            for (String vItemName : new ArrayList<>(vRoom.getItems().keySet())) {
124                                vRoom.removeItem(vItemName);
125                            }
126
127                            // Add saved items
128                            if (!vItemsData.isEmpty()) {
129                                for (String vItemPair : vItemsData.split(";")) {
130                                    if (!vItemPair.isEmpty()) {
131                                        String[] vItemParts = vItemPair.split("=");
132                                        if (vItemParts.length == 2) {
133                                            vRoom.addItem(vItemParts[0],new Item(vItemParts[0],Integer.parseInt(vItemParts[1])));
134                                        }
135                                    }
136                                }
137                            }
138                        }
139                    }
140                }
141            }
142
143            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Game loaded from " + vFileName);
144            pGameEngine.getGui().println(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getLongDescription());
145            if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getImageName() != null) {
146                pGameEngine.getGui().showImage(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getImageName());
147                if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItem("map") != null) {
148                    pGameEngine.getGui().showMap(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getMapImageName());
149                }
150            }
151
152            return false;
153
154        } catch (IOException e) {
155            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Error loading game: " + e.getMessage());
156            return false;
157        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
158            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Save file corrupted!");
159            return false;
160        }
161    } // execute()
162}
